references.text: The same prophetic formulation ('lift up your head') shows God's sovereign control over both life and death for two different people in the same context.
This verse documents the concrete fulfillment of the prophecy about restoration mentioned in the source verse.
This verse shows the actual restoration of the cupbearer to his position as predicted in the source verse.
Both texts illustrate Pharaoh as an instrument in God's hand to fulfill a specific purpose (restoration of Joseph versus revelation of God's power).
